macro.text: Near its lowest close in weeks. Index premium is thin right now, so favor individual names with richer pricing over index funds this week.

macro.text: Highest since January 2025. Rich bond yields are pulling money out of utilities, REITs and telecoms; consider selling calls closer to the stock price on any of those you hold.

days.name: Thursday
days.rule: No catalyst today, and volatility builds toward Friday’s jobs report, so options only get pricier as the day runs. Doing nothing is the correct trade here; use today only to close any short-dated position you don’t want carrying into Friday.
days.event: No new positions today. Hold ahead of Friday’s jobs report.

days.name: Friday
days.rule: Wait for the 5:30 AM Pacific jobs-report reaction to settle before opening anything. A strong jobs number is being read as bad news right now (higher odds of a rate hike), so let the initial move play out first.
